_note: Acceptance rules for the hill climb (compare.py). Score: must beat the best by score_min_gain. Guards: 'step' guards may not get worse than the best by more than their tolerance; 'floor' guards must stay at or above their floor. Measured run-to-run noise of the measure (different synthetic noise seeds) is under 0.005 dB, so tolerances are about real change, not noise. Speed is measured on the 4-core cloud machine.
